@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3YR05Z28B6DMHMSRK03QP9Q
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Model: SessionModel folds updates through the engine into entries and last-value state'
+---
+## What
+New `@MainActor @Observable public final class SessionModel` in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`. This task covers the fold only (no stream, no prompt, no pending requests).
+
+- [ ] Hold the FoundationModelsACP merge engine (the `Sendable` struct that replaces `SessionUpdateAggregator`). An internal `apply(_ update: SessionUpdate)` gives the update to the engine and reads its change value: `entry added` appends a new entry object to `transcript`; `entry changed` calls `update(from:)` on that one object only; `state changed` writes the last-value property.
+- [ ] Public read-only state: `sessionId`, `transcript: [TranscriptEntry]`, `availableCommands: [AvailableCommand]?` (nil = not reported), `configOptions`, `usage`, `agentState` (running / idle(stopReason) / requiresAction), `sessionInfo`. `StopReason.unknown(String)` stays raw (for example `_truncated`).
+- [ ] Unknown `SessionUpdate` cases and unknown content blocks become `unknown` entries with the raw JSON. Plan entries keep their first position. Terminal chunks append and snapshots replace (the engine supplies the rule; this model only reflects it).
+- [ ] Keep the display-rate chunk coalescing of `ACPSessionState` (33 ms cadence, injectable `Clock`, any non-chunk update flushes first, `flushPendingChunks()`). Port the logic, not the class.
+- [ ] Internal `seed(availableCommands:configOptions:...)` for the new / resume response values.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Every `SessionUpdate` case lands in `transcript` or in a last-value property; none is dropped.
+- [ ] A chunk for entry A causes no observation change on entry B.
+- [ ] `availableCommands` is nil before any report, and `[]` after an empty `available_commands_update`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/SessionModelFoldTests.swift`: one test per update case (reuse `SessionUpdateFixtures.swift`); an unknown update gives an `unknown` entry with raw JSON; `_truncated` stop reason stays `.unknown("_truncated")`; plan replace keeps position; per-entry observation isolation with `withObservationTracking`.
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/SessionModelCoalescingTests.swift`: port the cases of `CoalescingTests.swift` with a manual clock.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter SessionModel` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
